Model questions

RES1500E FAQ

What is the rated capacity of the RES1500E?

The stated rated capacity is 1,500 kg. Final suitability depends on load center, lift height, attachment, and operating conditions.

What is the lift specification of the RES1500E?

The listed lift specification is 1,600-3,500 mm. Confirm the required maximum height and residual capacity before ordering.

What information is needed to quote the RES1500E?

Provide load weight and dimensions, lift height, aisle or route conditions, daily duty, battery requirement, quantity, and destination.
